notes: This portable C++ TCK case uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It subscribes to standard HLAreportMOMexception, sends HLAsetSwitches parameters with out-of-range HLAresignAction and HLAswitch enumeration values, and checks both reliable report payloads and unchanged public switch state. It does not constrain the synchronous exception type or text and uses no provider-specific names, headers, registries, or internal state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM lookup, subscription, interaction invocation, callback service, automatic-resign and Service Reporting queries, and lifecycle; FederateAmbassador.receiveInteraction report observation
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::getInteractionClassHandle, RTIambassador::getParameterHandle, RTIambassador::getTransportationTypeHandle, RTIambassador::getFederateHandle, RTIambassador::subscribeInteractionClass, RTIambassador::getAutomaticResignDirective, RTIambassador::getServiceReportingSwitch, RTIambassador::sendInteraction, RTIambassador::evokeCallback, FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction
